name: Reeves's Pheasant
rangeDescription: Low-altitude deciduous forest of north-central china
description: A large terrestrial bird of hill forests. Male has very long black-and-white tail and is strikingly patterned: appears crafted out of black-edged gold and white porcelain scales.

name: Biak Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A small dull-colored warbler with a greenish upperside, instinct wingbars, a pale throat, and yellowish underparts. Singles, pairs, and small groups inhabit lowland and hill forest, including secondary forest.

name: Bedford's Paradise-Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Eastern democratic republic of the congo (northeastern ituri and region west of itombwe and kahuzi mountains)
description: An unusual paradise-flycatcher, slate-gray overall with a slightly darker head. Males have slightly elongated central tail feathers.

name: Flame-crowned Manakin
rangeDescription: Amazonian brazil (south of the amazon river), far southeastern peru, and northern and northeastern bolivia
description: Fairly large manakin. Males are distinctive, with a black head and an orange-red center of the crown that is often concealed; upperparts olive and underparts rusty, contrasting with a pure white throat.

name: Sinaloa Martin
rangeDescription: Breeds sierra madre occidental of western mexico; winter range unknown
description: Large swallow; very local summer resident in mountains of northwest Mexico. Favors open pine-oak forest, usually with big dead pine snags and cliffs, where nests in cavities.

name: Black-crowned Scimitar-Babbler
rangeDescription: Himalayas (eastern nepal to eastern assam north of the brahmaputra)
description: A large and vocal babbler of montane rainforest and shrubby edges. Note warm russet-brown body with bright rufous chest, white throat, white-bordered black mask, and a bright red bill.

name: Christmas Island Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Inland plateau of christmas island (eastern indian ocean)
description: Large slate-gray pigeon with glossy green iridescence (can be difficult to make out in poor light) on the back and wings. Also note staring yellow eyes, chestnut undertail coverts, and faint pale patch just above the bill.

name: Orange Chat
rangeDescription: Interior of australia, to southern and western coasts
description: Brightly colored, terrestrial songbird found in open and arid regions across much of inland Australia. Male has rich bright orange head and underparts, with a dramatic throat that extends to the dark eye.
imageCreditName: Laurie Ross | Tracks Birding & Photography Tours

name: Orange-billed Babbler
rangeDescription: Humid forest of sri lanka
description: A large, uniform rufous-brown babbler with conspicuous orange bill and feet, and a beady yellow eye. Highly gregarious, usually encountered in noisy flocks within wet rainforest understory.

name: Indian Skimmer
rangeDescription: Rivers and lakes of indian subcontinent and mekong delta
description: Unmistakable; black above and white below with bright orange bill (lower mandible longer than the upper). Favors slow-moving rivers with sandbars, on which this species forms noisy colonies, often in association with terns.

name: Claudia's Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Mountains of western china to eastern tibet; winters to southern china and southeastern asia
description: One of the Blyth’s-type warblers, this species regularly flicks its wings one after the other. Usually forages actively high up in the canopy, clambering along branches.

name: Pied Stilt
rangeDescription: Indonesia to australia and new zealand; winters to philippines
description: Large black-and-white shorebird with long straight, needle-like bill, and very long pink legs. Note black hind-neck.

name: Guadalcanal Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Mountains of guadalcanal (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A medium-sized honeyeater, mostly dark bluish-gray with olive tones to the upperparts. Bill relatively short and slightly decurved.

name: Least Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Breeds canada and usa; winters northern mexico to panama
description: Small, grayish-olive flycatcher; very similar to several other species. Look for relatively bold white eyeing, small bill, and frequent wing flicking.

name: Pied Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Sulawesi region, including sangihe, manterawu, bangka, togian, and banggai islands (off northeast) and kabaena, muna, buton, and selayar islands (off southeast)
description: Male is a striking, heavy-billed black-and-white bird, all black above except for a large white rump, with underparts entirely white but for the dark tail. Female is similar, but gray instead of black, and has a gray throat.

name: Klages's Antwren
rangeDescription: Central amazonian brazil
description: Tiny, compact antwren with a short tail. Males are gray and heavily streaked black.

name: Red-lored Whistler
rangeDescription: Southeastern south australia, adjacent northwestern victoria, and southwestern and central new south wales
description: Chunky gray songbird with a heavy black bill found in dry forest and bushland in parts of semi-arid southern Australia. Male has pale orange throat that extends above bill, gray breast, and paler belly.

name: Taiwan Bush-Robin
rangeDescription: Mountains of taiwan
description: Small, furtive, ground-dwelling songbird with thin white eyebrow. Adult males are slaty above and dusky ochre below, with a bright white eyebrow.

name: Cinnamon Bittern
rangeDescription: India to southeastern asia, philippines, and indonesia
description: Small heron of wet and open grassy areas such as flooded meadows and paddy fields. Uniformly bright rufous upperparts of adult male unmistakable.

name: Campbell Islands Teal
rangeDescription: Dent island (campbell island group); reintroduced and established on campbell island, where had become extinct
description: The smallest of the three endemic New Zealand teal species. Small, flightless dark brown duck.
